title: Mini-IELTS Writing: Global Renewable Electricity Generation (2000–2025)

writingTask.prompt: The line graph shows the percentage of electricity generated from wind, solar, and hydro sources in four European nations from 2000 to 2025.
bulletPoints: Wind power demonstrated the steepest upward trajectory, surging from 5% to 38% in Denmark.
Hydro power remained constant at approximately 55% in Norway, representing the highest overall share.
Solar energy experienced exponential growth after 2012 in Germany, peaking at 28% in 2025.
writingTask.sampleEssay: Band 8.5 Model: The line graph illustrates the share of electricity derived from three renewable sources across four European countries over a 25-year period... Overall, all nations experienced an upward trend, with solar exhibiting the most dramatic expansion.

title: Mini-IELTS Writing: Adult Educational Attainment by Gender (1980 vs 2020)

writingTask.prompt: The bar chart compares the percentage of men and women completing tertiary education degrees across five OECD countries in 1980 and 2020.
bulletPoints: Female graduation rates rose sharply across all surveyed nations, overtaking male rates by 2020.
In Canada, female tertiary graduation reached 62% in 2020 compared to only 28% in 1980.
Male graduation rates experienced modest steady increases of between 8% and 15%.
writingTask.sampleEssay: Band 8.5 Model: The bar chart provides a comparative breakdown of university graduation percentages... In summary, tertiary attainment rose across all surveyed countries, with females reversing the gender disparity by 2020.

title: Mini-IELTS Writing: Household Energy Consumption Breakdown in the UK

writingTask.prompt: The pie charts compare how an average UK household utilized energy across heating, water, appliances, and lighting in 1990 and 2020.
bulletPoints: Space heating accounted for more than half of all domestic energy use in both years (52% in 1990 and 48% in 2020).
Energy dedicated to consumer electrical appliances doubled from 12% to 24%.
Lighting efficiency gains lowered lighting consumption from 14% to 8%.
writingTask.sampleEssay: Band 8.5 Model: The two pie charts delineate the proportion of domestic energy consumed across four functional categories... Overall, space heating remained the predominant energy sink throughout both decades.

title: Mini-IELTS Writing: Industrial Lithium-Ion Battery Recycling Procedure

writingTask.prompt: The diagram illustrates the chemical and mechanical stages involved in recycling spent automotive lithium-ion batteries.
bulletPoints: Phase 1: Automated mechanical shredding under inert argon atmosphere prevents thermal runaway.
Phase 2: Hydrometallurgical acid leaching extracts cobalt, nickel, and lithium salts at 98% purity.
Phase 3: Precipitation and calcination regenerates reusable cathode precursor compounds.
writingTask.sampleEssay: Band 8.5 Model: The schematic outlines the cyclical industrial process of recovering valuable elements from spent lithium-ion battery packs... Overall, the system consists of three distinct phases converting waste cells into battery-grade precursors.

title: Mini-IELTS Writing: Redevelopment of Port Haven Industrial Docks (2000–Present)

writingTask.prompt: The two maps compare Port Haven in the year 2000 and following its urban waterfront revitalization today.
bulletPoints: Disused cargo cranes and timber warehouses in the north were converted into mixed-use residential apartments and an art gallery.
The central commercial shipping dock was converted into a recreational marina with a pedestrian promenade.
A light rail tram terminus was installed connecting the waterfront directly to the city center.
writingTask.sampleEssay: Band 8.5 Model: The comparative maps depict structural alterations undertaken at Port Haven between 2000 and the present day... Overall, the port underwent extensive modernization, transitioning from heavy freight shipping to residential and recreational hospitality.

title: Mini-IELTS Writing: Formal Complaint Regarding Delayed Flight & Lost Luggage

writingTask.prompt: You recently traveled on an international flight where your luggage was delayed for four days, causing significant inconvenience.
bulletPoints: Introduce your flight details, booking reference, and baggage tags.
Explain the specific problems and expenses caused by the delay.
State clearly the financial compensation and action you expect the airline to take.
writingTask.sampleEssay: Band 8.5 Model: Dear Customer Relations Manager, I am writing to lodge a formal complaint regarding flight BA-284 from London Heathrow to Singapore on October 14th...

title: Mini-IELTS Writing: Letter to Apartment Landlord Requesting Urgent Heating Repair

writingTask.prompt: You are renting an apartment, and the central heating boiler has stopped functioning during winter. Write a letter to your landlord.
bulletPoints: State the exact nature and onset date of the heating breakdown.
Explain the severe impact on your living conditions in cold weather.
Request an immediate technician inspection within 24 hours.
writingTask.sampleEssay: Band 8.5 Model: Dear Mr. Robinson, I am writing to bring to your urgent attention a serious mechanical failure concerning the central heating boiler at Apartment 4B...

title: Mini-IELTS Writing: Automation & AI Replacing Human White-Collar Jobs

writingTask.prompt: Some experts predict that artificial intelligence will render the majority of white-collar professional careers obsolete within decades. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
bulletPoints: Examine high-frequency analytical tasks (legal discovery, radiology, basic software coding) being automated.
Contrast with uniquely human skills: nuanced ethical judgment, empathetic counseling, and creative conceptual leaps.
Conclude with a balanced view that roles will transform collaboratively rather than disappear.
writingTask.sampleEssay: Band 8.5 Model: It is increasingly argued that rapid breakthroughs in generative AI and autonomous systems will displace skilled white-collar professionals... I largely disagree with the claim of wholesale obsolescence; while clerical workflows will automate, strategic human judgment remains indispensable.

title: Mini-IELTS Writing: Universal Basic Income (UBI) vs Traditional Welfare Programs

writingTask.prompt: Some believe governments should provide every citizen with an unconditional Universal Basic Income (UBI). Others argue that targeted conditional welfare assistance is more effective and fiscally sustainable. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
bulletPoints: UBI benefits: Eradicates bureaucratic stigma, provides economic safety net during automation transitions.
Targeted welfare arguments: Prevents wasteful disbursements to affluent demographics, maintains incentive to seek employment.
Personal synthesis: Phased negative income tax targeting low-to-middle brackets.
writingTask.sampleEssay: Band 8.5 Model: The economic debate regarding whether state welfare should take the form of unconditional universal payments or targeted conditional assistance has intensified... While UBI eliminates bureaucratic overhead, I believe targeted welfare preserves sovereign fiscal solvency.

title: Mini-IELTS Writing: Urban Sprawl and Traffic Congestion in Megacities

writingTask.prompt: In many global metropolises, increasing urban sprawl and private automobile dependency create severe air pollution and lost economic productivity. What are the primary causes of this issue, and what feasible measures can municipal governments implement?
bulletPoints: Causes: Inadequate commuter public transit, low-density single-family zoning, subsidized highway construction.
Solutions: High-density transit-oriented development (TOD), congestion pricing zones, investing in electrified metro lines.
writingTask.sampleEssay: Band 8.5 Model: Rapid urbanization over recent decades has catalyzed sprawling suburban peripheries, resulting in acute vehicular congestion... This essay will examine the underlying architectural drivers and propose systemic infrastructure remedies.
